name: agentcents

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Spend summary from the local agentcents ledger (by tag/model, last N hours).

tools.name: get_recent
tools.description: The most recent proxied calls: model, tokens, cost, latency, status.

tools.name: explain_request
tools.description: Forecast what an LLM request will cost on every candidate model BEFORE running it. Returns per-candidate p50→p90 ranges, the cheapest capable pick, an instability flag, and a Mermaid showdown diagram.

tag.description: task tag — selects the output histogram

tools.name: get_accuracy
tools.description: Calibration report: predicted vs actual for past calls — p90 coverage against its 90% target and q-error against 1.00. Says whether the forecasts have earned trust.

tools.name: get_histogram
tools.description: The output-token distribution the estimator runs on for a tag (p50/p90/samples).

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Reconstruct a session as a DAG of calls with per-node costs and the cost-routed counterfactual. Includes a Mermaid diagram.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Models this machine has actually used, with catalog prices.

tools.name: get_budget_status
tools.description: Configured budgets, current spend against them, and recent alerts.

tools.name: get_savings_estimate
tools.description: Free headline: how much of recent spend sits on frontier-priced models and a plausible savings range if that work moved down a tier.

tools.name: get_routing_advice
tools.description: Pro: per-tag recommendations for which of the user's own workloads can move to cheaper models, learned from their ledger. Without Pro this returns the free aggregate plus the upgrade path — never an error.

tools.name: activate_license
tools.description: Activate an agentcents Pro license key on this machine (local state only).

instructions: agentcents meters, forecasts and budget-enforces LLM calls on this machine. Prefer explain_request before recommending a model; prefer get_accuracy before trusting a forecast. Costs are ranges, never point estimates. Local models cost ~$0 — saying so is allowed.
